text:
Alex: RCA published for the latency spike on 2026-03-20 — link: https://intranet.redwood/rca/2310001234. Short summary: cache eviction storms during autoscale caused a cascade of cold starts and request queuing for the text-gen pool. Root cause, timeline, and mitigations all in the doc.

Maria: Thanks Alex — can you call out the two immediate action items at the top so folks don't miss them?

Alex: Good call. Top actions added. TL;DR: 1) Rework eviction policy to prefer long-lived prefixes (owner: Maria, target: 2026-03-27). 2) Add a warmup ramp to autoscale events (owner: Sam, target: 2026-03-24).

Sam: I can take the warmup ramp. Question: do we want a fixed ramp (e.g., +10% qps per minute) or a metric-based probe?

Jen: Metric-based probe + short fixed ramp as fallback. We had a case where probes were delayed and user traffic dropped into a hole.

Priya: Assigned to run the eviction-policy experiment next week. I'll create a perf bench and load test matrix.

oncall-bot: INCIDENT TIMELINE: 2026-03-20 02:11 UTC - first error spike; 02:19 - autoscale triggered; 02:22 - cache thrash observed; 02:45 - mitigation by draining node pool; 03:10 - service recovered. Full timeline: https://intranet.redwood/incidents/2310001234-timeline

Alex: Action items section in RCA (short):
- Maria: update eviction policy config and ship dev->staging (due 2026-03-27)
- Sam: implement ramp + probe in autoscaler (due 2026-03-24)
- Priya: perf validation and canary plan (due 2026-03-26)
- Jen: add alert thresholds for cache miss surge + playbook steps (due 2026-03-25)
- Ops: schedule 1-week follow-up checkpoint (owner: Alex, meeting: 2026-03-30 16:00 UTC)

Maria: I've started a draft PR for eviction config, putting notes in the RCA about safe thresholds.

Sam: I'll prototype the ramp in the autoscaler branch and post a short demo.

Jen: For alerts, suggest `cache.miss_rate` + `instance.startup_latency` composite. If either spikes > 3x baseline, we fallback to lower traffic.

Priya: Test plan: will run three workload profiles (steady, bursty, prefix-heavy). I'll include warmup simulation.

Alex: Please add short comments in the RCA confirming owners. We'll close the loop after the follow-up checkpoint.

Sam: quick note — for local repro I used this command to simulate eviction pressure:
```
wrk -t4 -c200 -d60s --latency http://staging-textgen.local/generate
```

Maria: acked. PR link will be in the RCA by EOD.

Priya: ping @everyone — can owners add estimated risk/rollout notes to the RCA so SRE oncall can run the canary?

Alex: done. I added a small rollout checklist and rollback triggers to the doc (search for "Rollout checklist").

Sam: noted. I'll include a canary that starts at 5% and steps to 50% over 30m if metrics stable.

Jen: I'll pair with oncall for the first canary.

Maria: thanks all. Anything else before I mark this follow-up as assigned?

Priya: nothing from me.

Alex: thanks — marking as published and scheduling the 2026-03-30 checkpoint. Please add any blockers as comments on the RCA. :thumbsup:
